items.title: Proxmox Datacenter Manager
items.message: Add PDM as a new module for centralized monitoring of PVE clusters, standalone PVE servers and PBS instances.

items.title: Run Datacenter Backup Jobs
items.message: Run existing Proxmox VE Datacenter Backup Jobs directly from Home Assistant.

items.title: Corosync QDevice Monitoring
items.message: Explore native PVE API monitoring for Corosync quorum and QDevice status in the CLUSTER module, including node availability and degraded QDevice connectivity.

items.title: VM Disk Usage
items.message: Explore optional VM filesystem usage monitoring through the QEMU Guest Agent, providing disk usage metrics for compatible VMs when explicitly enabled by the user.
